LanguageData.ATPP_Android2KTX.label: TX2K Android
LanguageData.ATPP_Android2KTX.description: A prototype android designed to be used exclusively on the battlefield as heavy infantry, very resistant and inflicts severe melee damage, however quite slow due to its armor and he is unable to perform advanced tasks because of its limited processor essentially optimized for combat.
LanguageData.ATPP_Android2KITX.label: TX2KI Android

LanguageData.ATPP_Android2ITX.label: TX2I Android
LanguageData.ATPP_Android2ITX.description: A serie of TX2 refurbished to be used as infantry on battlefields rather than T2, mainly due to the fear inspired on their organic enemies due to their particular appearance.

LanguageData.ATPP_Android4TX.label: TX4 Android
